name: Operation Head of Bosch China Training Center

jobDescription.title: Job Description
jobDescription.text:
Role Purpose

As Operation Head of Bosch China Training Center, you will lead the team and be accountable for center operations, delivery quality, budget and cost efficiency, customer satisfaction, team capability, and enablement solutions across Bosch China. You will champion breakthrough AI applications in learning, cultivate deep advisory partnerships with Business, integrate seamlessly with the Talent Development (TD) team, and build a high-performing, customer-centric organizational enablement ecosystem.

Key Responsibilities

1. Lead Training Center Operations & Delivery Excellence
Own the center’s operating model and annual operating plan. Translate the learning portfolio into operational plans, and manage capacity, scheduling, faculty and vendor deployment, venue and platform operations, and end-to-end delivery. Set service standards and SLAs; track KPIs such as utilization, cost per delivery, quality, satisfaction, and ROI. Drive process standardization, cost efficiency, and compliance, running the center as an internal service provider with clear accountability for quality and value.

qualifications.title: Qualifications
qualifications.text:
Qualifications & Requirements

  1. Solid experience in HR Learning & Development, Talent Development business partnership, or management consulting. Leading a strategic culture transformation is a plus.
  2. Experience in portfolio planning, lifecycle management, and commercial operations for training or consulting products. Strong product mindset and P&L awareness.
  3. Strong business sense, root-cause analysis, and consultative communication skills. Able to engage cross-functional stakeholders or senior executives.
  4. Good understanding and hands-on experience with AI and emerging learning technologies.
  5. Bachelor’s degree or above. Fluent in spoken and written Chinese and English. Able to use both for executive reporting and cross-border project steering.
